title: Friday's Game
pitch: Lenny lost big at Victor's Friday card game and paid with a promise. Now he wants a discount. Collect the full debt.

clue_a.label: Container twelve
lines: A card table inside container twelve. Chairs for eight, a cash box, and a sign: house takes ten percent.

clue_b.label: The launch at the steps
lines: A brand new outboard on Lenny's launch, the price tag still on the cowl. A man with that isn't broke.
